pages.summary: 26 named procurement windows across UK (10) / EU (8) / US (5) / AUKUS (3) Q3-2026 → Q4-2027. ~£4.8B addressable value. 14 HIGH-fit for direct bid (DASA, Dstl SERAPIS, UKDI, MOD IFS TC-008, NCSC ACD 4, Dstl AI T&E, UK AISI Tier 2, EU GPAI CoP, EDF 2026, EuroHPC AI Factories, EU AI Office Sandboxes, ENISA Cyber Reserve, EU Sovereign AI Stack Horizon, NATO DIANA Cohort 5, AUKUS Pillar 2). 5 LOW-fit out of scope (biometrics, kinetic, autonomous lethal — DEFONEOS red lines).

5 named transfer mechanisms (Adequacy, SCCs+UK Addendum, IDTA, BCR, Art-49 derogations) × 14 jurisdictions. SIGIL-anchored TIA template (8 sections). 7 Schrems II supplementary measures (BYOK encryption, source pseudonymisation, BFT-cleared access, contractual prohibition, annual TIA re-assessment, real-time transfer log, data minimisation). EU-US DPF + UK-US Data Bridge certified.

12-step Day-90 closeout sequence (5 BD total) × 6 buyer artefacts (data, logs, evaluations, Model Card, incident record, post-pilot report) × empty-volume SIGIL-anchored deletion attestations × 33-agent BFT council vote (≥23/33 quorum) × mandatory NCC Group escrow verification for Sovereign tiers × 30-day post-pilot support window × 90-day renewal window at preferred-vendor pricing × 5 edge cases (insolvency / regulatory hold / force majeure).
